cases.sentence: — Прогнать меня — это ___, чем то, что ты уже сделал со мной.
cases.explain: «большее зло» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!” But he would not listen to her.

cases.sentence: (А на ней была богато украшенная одежда, которую носили в то время незамужние ___.) 19 Фамарь посыпала голову пеплом и разорвала свою богатую одежду.
cases.explain: «царские дочери» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: She had a garment of various colors on her; for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.

cases.explain: «царский пир» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

cases.sentence: А все ___ поднялись, сели на своих мулов и бежали.
cases.explain: «царские сыновья» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule, and fled.

cases.sentence: Пока они были в пути, к Давиду пришла весть: «Авессалом поразил всех ___; никого из них не осталось».
cases.explain: «царских сыновей» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”

cases.sentence: Юноша, стоявший в дозоре, взглянул и увидел множество людей, спускающихся по ___ со склона холма.
cases.explain: «хоронаимской дороге» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.

cases.sentence: Когда он закончил говорить, с громким плачем вошли ___.
cases.explain: «царские сыновья» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voice, and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.

cases.sentence: И ___, и все его слуги тоже очень горько плакали.
cases.explain: «сам царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voice, and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.
